userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: The issue was resolved during the interaction, by an action or an answer.
The gate or door was opened for the customer as the resolution.
The interaction was handed to another agent or system.
A manager, attendant or other role took over or was asked to act (see escalationContacts and ApprovalRequest).
The customer needed no assistance by the time the agent answered.
The customer left or the contact ended before a resolution.
The customer will be called back; raises customerCallbackRequested when the site must do it.
